description: Synthetic feature-flag catalog for the campaign sandbox. All names, owners, and descriptions are fictional and public-safe. Presentation roles describe the state each flag is intended to reach at the mature live-demo checkpoint; they are not the flag's current state.

flags.name: Checkout rollout
flags.description: Gradual rollout of the rebuilt checkout submission path.
flags.anchor: Broadly consumed across services and carries the bounded Production load probe. Stays active and referenced for the whole campaign.

flags.name: Legacy profile
flags.description: Serves the previous profile rendering path while the replacement is finished.
flags.anchor: The young-flag/old-code dangling-reference case. Must never be presented as safe to archive.

flags.name: Retired banner
flags.description: Site-wide promotional banner retained only until the campaign ended.
flags.anchor: Becomes a demonstrably archived case once its real evidence gates pass.

flags.name: Cart v2
flags.description: Replacement cart aggregation and totals service.

flags.name: Search ranking v3
flags.description: Third-generation relevance ranking for catalog search.

flags.name: Personalized home
flags.description: Personalized storefront landing page. Rolled back after a regression.
flags.anchor: The rollback/abandonment case: enabled, then reverted, then left dormant.

flags.name: Inventory reservation
flags.description: Soft reservation of stock during checkout.

flags.name: Pricing engine v2
flags.description: Rules-based replacement for the legacy pricing calculator.

flags.name: Payment retry
flags.description: Operational control for automatic retry of soft-declined payments.
flags.anchor: The permanent operational control. Never a cleanup candidate; excluded from archive gates by intent.

flags.name: Shipping estimates
flags.description: Carrier-derived delivery estimates on the product page.

flags.name: Email notifications v2
flags.description: Templated transactional email delivery pipeline.

flags.name: SMS notifications
flags.description: Order status by SMS, deliberately limited to two regions.
flags.anchor: The intentionally limited flag: a partial rollout that is finished, not stalled.

flags.name: Identity passkeys
flags.description: Passkey sign-in alongside the existing password flow.

flags.name: Subscription pause
flags.description: Self-service pause and resume for recurring subscriptions.

flags.name: Support assistant
flags.description: Assisted reply suggestions in the support console.

flags.name: Catalog enrichment
flags.description: Supplementary attributes merged into catalog records.

flags.name: Order history v2
flags.description: Paginated order history with combined shipment views.

flags.name: Profile preferences
flags.description: Consolidated notification and privacy preferences in the profile.
flags.anchor: Protected live-demo archive candidate. Never archived during the screenshot schedule or rehearsal.

flags.name: Checkout address validation
flags.description: Inline address verification before payment authorisation.

flags.name: Recommendation model v2
flags.description: Replacement ranking model for related-product recommendations.

flags.name: Fraud screening
flags.description: Additional screening step for high-risk orders.

flags.name: Tax calculation v2
flags.description: Jurisdiction-aware tax calculation replacing the flat-rate table.

flags.name: Express returns
flags.description: Label-free express returns for eligible orders.
flags.anchor: Protected live-demo archive candidate. Never archived during the screenshot schedule or rehearsal.

flags.name: Storefront navigation
flags.description: Restructured primary navigation for the storefront.
